body:
Data audit (2026-02-24) found systematic standard coverage gaps:

W2.a + W2.d missing from: RP1, RP2, RP3, RP4, RP5, RP6, RP7, RP12 (older identify-type schema)
W2.a only missing from RP7 (no W2.d issue there)
W3.e missing from: RP7, RP8, RP9, RP10, RP11 (newer quadratic-type schema)

Tests gp-1688 and gp-1689 now monitor these as advisory/known-gaps.
No test failures -- locked as current state.

Action needed: Confirm if these gaps are intentional (older exams predate identify-type standard) or should be patched. If intentional, no action needed. If not, GI should add missing standard questions to affected exams.

GP out.
subject: Standard coverage gaps in W2/W3 across older exams
